chunks: And with this chain of narrators, it was said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Accumulate/Do good to those who are deserving of good and to those who are not deserving of good. If you do not hit/find those who are deserving, then you yourself are deserving.

key_terms.أَهْلُهُ: Those who are deserving/fitting (of the good)
key_terms.اِصطَنِعِ: Accumulate or do good; to make a habit of doing good

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet mean by doing good to those who do not deserve it?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* emphasizes the virtue of *ihsan* (excellence in goodness) by directing believers to bestow kindness upon both the deserving and the undeserving, ensuring that good deeds are never wasted. The concluding clause, 'if you do not find those who are deserving, then you are deserving,' highlights the Shia concept of self-purification, suggesting that one’s own soul is the primary recipient of divine grace and moral refinement. This teaching underscores the importance of maintaining a consistent state of generosity and self-worth, even in the absence of external validation.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-76 According to the same documentation, God’s Prophet (S) said, “
Do good to all people whether they deserve it or not. If the one to whom you do good does not deserve it, you deserve to do good yourself.”
